meta.title: Mobilcab — from idea to panel, straight from your browser
meta.description: Cloud-based furniture CAD that runs in your browser, on laptop, tablet or phone. 3D design and cut lists — nesting and CNC by stage.

hero.title: From idea to panel, straight from your browser.
hero.body: Mobilcab is a cloud-based CAD for furniture — works on laptop, tablet, or phone. No installs, no license servers. Design it and get to the cut list; nesting and CNC come by stage.
hero.note: Founding Partner: join the waitlist now; discount on Basic when we ship M2. Later subscribers pay list price.

problem.title: Sound familiar?
items: Heavy CAD software installed on one single workshop computer
Expensive licenses for features you barely use
Hours lost manually building the cutlist for your CNC
No easy way to show a live design to a client on-site, from your phone

items.title: 100% browser-based
items.body: No install, no license server. Open it on any device — laptop, tablet, phone.

items.title: AI design assistant
items.body: Suggests panel layouts and flags errors before they reach the saw.

items.title: From design to cut list
items.body: Parts lists for the workshop; nesting, labels and quotes as we ship each stage.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.offerDetail: Join the FP waitlist with no payment. When we open paid Basic with M2, people on the list get a discount. Anyone who subscribes later pays full list.
pricing.aiNote: Basic at M2 = workshop tools (no CNC in that plan). AI and CNC come separately, by stage.
pricing.free: The app is free until we open paid plans.
pricing.cancel: Joining the FP waitlist does not oblige you to pay.

items.q: Do I need to install anything?
items.a: No, Mobilcab runs straight from your browser.

items.q: Does it work on a tablet?
items.a: Yes, it's built for laptop, tablet and phone.

items.q: Can I export directly for my CNC?
items.a: The cut list is the foundation; CNC export comes in a later roadmap stage.
Now: the app is free. Join the Founding Partner waitlist for a discount on Basic when we ship M2. Later subscribers pay list price.
